files.Title: SpawnThat.Options.Conditions.ConditionOceanDepth
files.Summary:
Required distance to water surface.

Ocean depth is calculated as Max(0, WaterLevel - Seafloor).

This means the water-surface and above will be ocean depth 0. An ocean floor at 10 meter below the surface will be 10.

files.Title: SpawnThat.Options.Modifiers.ModifierDefaultRollLevel
files.Summary:
Simulates the vanilla level assignment logic.

Level is assigned by setting level to Min(1, minLevel).

If minDistanceForLevelups is greater than distance to center, and maxLevel is greater than level, the levelupChance is rolled. This is repeated until either maxLevel is reached, or a levelup roll fails.

files.Title: SpawnThat.Options.Modifiers.ModifierDespawnOnConditionsInvalid

files.Title: SpawnThat.Options.PositionConditions.ISpawnPositionCondition

Spawn position conditions are specialized conditions that must all be met, for a template to be allowed to spawn.

Typically these are checked multiple times, while the game samples multiple spots in the world for a valid position.

files.Title: SpawnThat.Spawners.SpawnAreaSpawner.ISpawnAreaSpawnBuilder
files.Summary:
Builder for the individual spawn entries of a SpawnArea spawner.

Multiple entries can exist pr spawner, and will be selected based on weight, after filtering for conditions.

files.Title: SpawnThat.Spawners.SpawnAreaSpawner.ISpawnAreaSpawnerBuilder
files.Summary:
Configuration for a SpawnArea spawner (eg. a greydwarf nest).

To identify which spawner to modify, set ISpawnerIdentifier's on the builder. When multiple configurations exist for the same spawner, the identifiers and their weights will be used to select the most specific configuration.

Spawner controls the general settings for when things should spawn. It selects what to spawn from a list of spawns, which can be modified or added to by using ISpawnAreaSpawnBuilder.

files.Title: SpawnThat.Spawners.SpawnAreaSpawner.SpawnAreaSpawnerSettings

files.Title: SpawnThat.Spawners.SpawnerConfigurationManager
files.Summary:
Handles configuration creation workflow.

When Lifecycle.OnLateInit and GameState is SinglePlayer or Dedicated, the manager initalizes a new ISpawnerConfigurationCollection, and runs subscribed configuration actions in the order:

  1. Actions for OnConfigure
  2. Actions for SubscribeConfiguration
  3. Configurations loaded from files

The collection is then finalized, and results are stored. If in Dedicated, and a player joins, the finalized templates are synced to player, to later be applied to the various spawners.

The way the configurations are applied to spawners depends on the spawner type.
